comments.comment: What is 50K per device?
comments.resolution: The +₹50K = FY26-27 uplift over the pricelist, added to device Quotation & Standard. Applies to DEVICES only. Misplaced device text removed from the Esthemax tab.

comments.comment: Is Sales Manager eligible for the 6-tier slab?
comments.resolution: Yes — answered in new Section E. Manager earns full slab only on own direct sales (incl. covering a vacant territory); reportee sales pay flat ₹200/box. No double-dipping. Worked example included.

comments.comment: Quotation can’t be standard; set on selling; value bands; buffers.
comments.resolution: Celluma Incentive REBUILT: Standard = selling price; bands <5L ₹5,000/₹3,500, 5–10L ₹10,000/₹7,500, >10L ₹20,000/₹15,000; +10% above-std (SP only); manager flat 50%. Minimum = selling − buffer.

comments.comment: Manager incentives can be 50% of salesperson.
comments.resolution: Applied — Section F manager rates are exactly 50% of Sales Person Std incentive, no above-std upside.

comments.comment: New incentive bands; below-std 70%; floor corrections.
comments.resolution: Device Incentive REBUILT on value-slabs: <15L ₹10,000 | 15–20L ₹15,000 | 20–30L ₹20,000 | 30–40L ₹25,000 | >40L ₹40,000. Below-std = 70%. +10% above-std (SP only). Floor corrections applied (Polylase ND rename, Vossman Blauman 18/16.5, etc.).

comments.comment: Manager 50% of SP; full SP rate where he sells direct.
comments.resolution: Applied — Section B manager = flat 50% of Std, no upside; full SP rates when manager sells directly (e.g. covering a vacant territory).

comments.comment: Spot not given last year; need quarterly targets; T&C doc.
comments.resolution: Spot incentive ₹4,000/mo RETAINED for FY26-27 (needs Arjun approval per rep). Company quarterly split (25%) added on Master Dashboard. New "Incentive T&C" tab created covering all schemes.

comments.comment: Landing method (EXW+30%); widen 50K→1L if excl. GST.
comments.resolution: Landing values & method retained as Surya entered. GST point actioned: device Minimum widened to Standard − ₹1L across Device Cost & Device Incentive.

comments.comment: Standard cost is 10+3 incl 18% GST; include Retail?
comments.resolution: Added Retail Hydrojelly (11 variants, 2 masks/box) and Collagen Foot Mask as separate sub-sections. Standard-cost basis retained. Foot Mask Total/MRP left draft (blank in source).

comments.comment: Same as incentive: standard=selling, min=selling−buffer.
comments.resolution: Celluma Cost aligned to the incentive tab: Standard = selling price, Minimum = selling − buffer (Pod 8K / 1–2L 20K / 2–5L 40K / 5–10L 75K / >10L 1L).

comments.comment: Use minimum value for targets; add Celluma; quarterly.
comments.resolution: VALUE TARGETS recomputed on Minimum device price (columns relabelled Min Price / Min Value, totals updated). CELLUMA added explicitly per HQ with quarterly (25%) split. New rule: 1/IC/month, manager rollup, vacant covered until filled, new joinees +3mo.

comments.comment: Reduce 1/person/month; quarterly.
comments.resolution: RULE SET: 1 Celluma / IC / month (12/yr). Manager carries reportee rollup (no double-count) and covers a vacant slot at 1/mo until filled. New joinees start 3 months after joining. Quarterly 25% each. Company total = 123 units.
